Initial Load	In the SUPPLY ANALYSIS Master data, we don't have a ACTIVE_IND to filter the records so all data will be loaded from the source to the ROOT table by truncating the existing records in the table.

Transformation	We don't have any major transformation now.

Transformation	We don't have any major transformation now.

Transformation	Active records will be time-traveled. On each master load, current table data moves to memories table.

1.) Proc Item identification for ITEM_ID: Join PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT on ITEM_ID If Join is found and PROC_ITEM_ID = NULL Then retain the ITEM_ID from source (PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT) If Join is found and PROC_ITEM_ID != NULL Then use PROC_ITEM_ID (from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT) 2.) Aggregating Quantity at PROC level: UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level, INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level, UNAVAILABLE_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate UNAVAILABLE_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level GROUP BY ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD for above aggregation of quantities Note: We re-aggregate and update the above quantities at a PROC_ITEM_ID level as they were previously aggregated at UPI_ITEM_ID level"
